svg.title: Square-to-round mouthpiece, trumpet layout - 30 rings, 25mm square bore to 3.66mm throat to ø16.5mm lip
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Station one is a sharp 25mm square aperture in a sharp 31mm square plate, matching the bore corner for corner. The corners round away going up and the section is a true circle from the 17.3176mm station on, so the 3.66mm throat and the whole cup are round. The trumpet layout: 26 backbore rings, 0 entrance rings, then 4 bowl rings to a ø16.5mm rim. Wall 3 to 4.80mm, 3mm of rise a ring, stack 90mm. Every joint seats on at least 1.00mm per side, flats and corners alike. Rings stack; they do not telescope.
